newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 28.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 3.49 points at 8113.44, after three straight days of record gains
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index were 4.63 points to 1,041.26, as cheapened stocks continued to be bought up.
* On Monday morning, the ringgit was rangebound. At 0100 GMT, it was at 2.6460/90 to a dollar, against 2.6460/90 at the close of Kuala Lumpur trading on Friday.
* "Focus will still be on currencies. There is a fear that ringgit will weaken further," said a dealer with a bank-backed brokerage. He said the market was still in consolidation.

* Newly listed Transmile and Konsortium Perkapalan, which are said to be in a restructuring programme expected to be in focus. Transmile is said to be buying 30 percent of government run courier Pos Laju and sell part of one of its subsidiary to Konsortium.
* Ekran Bhd, which announced it was buying its chairman Ting Pek Khiing's stakes in associates PWE Industries and Granite Industries.
